tested_object: Regularization-scale sensitivity of the exact 64h N0 one-hour linear accessibility probe on adaptively reused January-February development

research_series_policy.adaptation_rationale: R6 showed 64h remained the strongest bounded context while its lambda=1 ridge point relation stayed weak and just below robust LCB; R8 isolates regularization scale before adding representation or learner complexity
research_series_policy.if_candidate_found: promote only the named ridge-lambda candidate to a new separately preregistered robustness/transfer experiment
research_series_policy.if_no_candidate_found: do_not_rescue_R8; no screened ridge scale receives promotion

adaptations_made_after_exposure: R8 regularization grid selected after observing R6/R7 weak 64h lambda=1 point relation

claims.tested_object: bounded comparative screen of ridge lambda 0.1/10/100/1000 against lambda=1 on the same 64h N0 one-hour relation

estimand.primary: for each candidate lambda: February Pearson correlation, true-minus-median-shuffle correlation, and paired correlation gain over lambda=1 under common resamples
estimand.candidate_rule: all three one-sided bootstrap lower bounds > 0; among eligible lambdas choose highest point true correlation; exact tie prefers lambda closest to 1 in log10 distance, then smaller lambda
estimand.unit: dependence-aware 48h circular moving block over the common February hourly sequence

claims.estimator: January-standardized closed-form ridge at frozen lambda grid, February Pearson correlation, eight matched shuffled-January-target controls, paired circular moving-block bootstrap
claims.replication_unit: 48h circular moving block; 4096 bootstrap replicates are uncertainty draws, not independent scientific replicates
validity_prerequisites: identical January/February timestamps for every lambda
same 64h N0 features and feature standardizer across lambdas
no February fitting or lambda selection during training
credible_alternatives: candidate gain may be finite-sample regularization luck on adaptively reused February
screening over multiple lambdas adds adaptation debt and is not confirmatory
lambda scale may interact with feature covariance and does not identify a representation root cause
a negative screen does not exclude other probe families
authority_scope: may prioritize one ridge lambda as a candidate for a new experiment
may conclude that none of the screened non-reference lambdas earned screening promotion

screen.feature_standardization: January fit mean/population-std; drop std<=1e-12; freeze for February
screen.candidate_selection: eligible lambda with highest point true correlation; exact tie chooses smallest abs(log10(lambda/reference)); remaining tie chooses smaller lambda

uncertainty_protocol.method: paired circular moving-block bootstrap over common February hourly indices
